method.sceneP99Summary: arithmetic mean of four per-scene P99 values, NOT a pooled percentile
method.scope: Apple M3 macOS15.8.2; uncapped rendering with 1ms loop sleep, deterministic 60Hz simulation; two maps at actual 1280x960 and 1920x1440 pixels; no timed observers/captures/pixel scans
method.readbackMetric: Sync call or async submission only. Async wait remains inside transfer; runtime destination copying may run inside present. Render/interval/CPU totals include those stages.

behavior.scope: detected macOS OpenGL Cocoa presenter only
behavior.comparison: all current BGRA bytes via memcmp against retained immutable CFData; unchanged pixel and point geometry required
behavior.readback: all complete current GPU readbacks and RGBA->BGRA conversion still run
behavior.unchangedImage: skip only repeated CFData copy/CGImage creation/native layer commit
behavior.changedImage: any changed byte, pixel shape, point geometry or view forces presentation
behavior.failures: never adopt failed data/image as the comparison reference
behavior.lifetime: one retained immutable CFData snapshot, released on successful replacement, view change and shutdown
behavior.baselinePipeline: one-frame latency, captures/observers stay current and async failure fallback unchanged

limits: Small FireRed mean scene render P99 increases about 10.5% (8.00->8.84ms) despite lower CPU. Individual percentiles still vary.
Emerald absolute CPU/tail values vary substantially across trials; external GPU/compositor/host load is uncontrolled. Do not pool absolute numbers with earlier tasks.
One-host short native flat-world checks are not full-gameplay/fullscreen/context-loss/long-duration acceptance or Windows hardware testing.
Complete GPU readback, channel shuffle, changed-frame copy/commit and waits remain costs.
One immutable full-frame snapshot is retained; presentation latency is unchanged from e95748e.
The earlier published native-preview-20261024.1 remains immutable; the Origami port stays paused.

nativeEquivalent.workload: same captured real FireRed 1280x960 frame; last red byte deliberately changes every second call, source restored at end; 8 ABBA/BAAB blocks, 100warm240measured each

rejectedNoCopy.reason: Direct owned native buffer with CFDataCreateWithBytesNoCopy was byte/lifetime-correct but did not give reliable real-game CPU improvement; not shipped.
rejectedNoCopy.shortPilotMethod: baseline then candidate per game,300warm300measure per scene,not full ABBA acceptance
